Interface ScriptActionsContract

All Known Implementing Classes:
ScriptActions, ScriptActions
public interface ScriptActionsContract
Script execution in the active browser realm using one optional argument.

Pass a List or Map as the single argument when a script needs several values. Selenium exposes it as arguments[0]; Playwright passes it as its native evaluation argument. Async Selenium scripts receive the completion callback after that optional argument, while Playwright awaits a returned promise.
